historicalEvidence.whyNot: Positive locked holdout but did not beat the maximum ROI observed among all 100 matched random portfolios.

prospectiveRequirements.randomTicketRule: For each replicate and observed jornada, generate exactly two tickets of six independent score-bucket codes. Each position is sampled uniformly from the frozen 16-code alphabet; use the same official ticket cost and payout table as the model tickets.
promotionRequires: exactly first 30 prospective jornadas after the pre-outcome frozen prediction
all 30 predictions sealed before their official results
all 30 official results and economics available
no model, window or ticket-count drift
no optional stopping or post-30 rescue

truth: The model was frozen before the first prospective outcome. Interim prospective performance is hidden until the fixed 30-jornada boundary; only administrative progress may be disclosed.
